Figure 5 script

#load('.R_data')
library(multcomp)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(patchwork)
library(DT)

1 R packages used

A variety of R packages was used for this analysis. All graphics and data wrangling were handled using the tidyverse suite of packages. All packages used are available from the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN), Bioconductor.org, or Github.

2 Interferons results

2.1 Data preparation

IFN_dat <- read.csv(file = 'fig5_IFNs_res.csv')
IFN_dat$Replicate <- as.factor(IFN_dat$Replicate)
IFN_dat$Infection <-
  as.factor(IFN_dat$Infection) %>% factor(levels = c('No infection', 
                                                     'C. parvum', 
                                                     'C. hominis'))
IFN_dat$Time <- as.factor(IFN_dat$Time)
IFN_dat$Analyte <- as.factor(IFN_dat$Analyte)

2.2 Statistics

kruskal_IFNs <- IFN_dat %>%
  group_by(Analyte) %>%
  kruskal_test(Corr_Value ~ Infection)

datatable(kruskal_IFNs)
dunn_IFNs <- IFN_dat %>%
  group_by(Analyte, Time) %>%
  dunn_test(Corr_Value ~ Infection) %>%
  add_xy_position(
    x = 'Time',
    scales = 'free',
    dodge = .75,
    fun = 'max')

datatable(dunn_IFNs)

2.3 Plot

IFN_plot <- ggbarplot(
  IFN_dat,
  'Time',
  'Corr_Value',
  fill = 'Infection',
  facet.by = 'Analyte',
  scales = 'free',
  nrow = 1,
  color = 'black',
  position = position_dodge(.75),
  add = c('mean_se', 'jitter'),
  add.params = list(
    color = 'black',
    shape = 21,
    fill = 'Infection',
    jitter = 0.1,
    width = .3
  ),
  error.plot = 'upper_errorbar',
  ylab = 'Concentration (pg/ml)',
  xlab = 'Time post-infection (h)',
  legend.title = '',
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
)  %>%
  ggpar(
    legend = 'none',
    orientation = 'vertical',
    x.text.angle = 0
    ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(labels = c(
    "No infection",
    expression(paste(italic("C. parvum"))),
    expression(paste(italic("C. hominis")))),
    palette = "Paired"
  )


IFN_plot <- IFN_plot +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    dunn_IFNs,
    label = 'p.adj.signif',
    tip.length = 0.01,
    hide.ns = T,
    step.increase = 0,
    bracket.nudge.y = -100
    )

print(IFN_plot)

3 Cytokines results

3.1 Data preparation

cyto_dat <- read.csv(file = 'fig5_cytokines_res.csv')
cyto_dat$Replicate <- as.factor(cyto_dat$Replicate)
cyto_dat$Infection <-
  as.factor(cyto_dat$Infection) %>% factor(levels = c('No infection', 
                                                     'C. parvum', 
                                                     'C. hominis'))
cyto_dat$Time <- as.factor(cyto_dat$Time)
cyto_dat$Analyte <- as.factor(cyto_dat$Analyte)

3.2 Statistics

kruskal_cyto <- cyto_dat %>%
  group_by(Analyte) %>%
  kruskal_test(Value ~ Infection)

datatable(kruskal_cyto)
dunn_cyto <- cyto_dat %>%
  group_by(Analyte, Time) %>%
  dunn_test(Value ~ Infection) %>%
  add_xy_position(
    x = 'Time',
    scales = 'free',
    dodge = .75, 
    fun = 'max')

datatable(dunn_cyto)

3.3 Plot

cyto_plot <- ggbarplot(
  cyto_dat,
  'Time',
  'Value',
  fill = 'Infection',
  facet.by = 'Analyte',
  scales = 'free',
  nrow = 1,
  color = 'black',
  position = position_dodge(.75),
  add = c('mean_se', 'jitter'),
  add.params = list(
    color = 'black',
    shape = 21,
    fill = 'Infection',
    jitter = 0.1,
    width = .3
  ),
  error.plot = 'upper_errorbar',
  ylab = 'Concentration (pg/ml)',
  xlab = 'Time post-infection (h)',
  legend.title = '',
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
)  %>%
  ggpar(
    legend = 'top',
    orientation = 'vertical',
    x.text.angle = 0
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(labels = c(
    "No infection",
    expression(paste(italic("C. parvum"))),
    expression(paste(italic("C. hominis")))),
    palette = "Paired"
  )


cyto_plot <- cyto_plot +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    dunn_cyto,
    label = 'p.adj.signif',
    tip.length = 0.01,
    hide.ns = T
  )

print(cyto_plot)

4 CSpV1 results

4.1 Data preparation

CSpV1_dat <- read.csv(file = 'fig5_CSpV1_res.csv')
CSpV1_dat$Replicate <- as.factor(CSpV1_dat$Replicate)
CSpV1_dat$Strain <-
  as.factor(CSpV1_dat$Strain) %>% factor(levels = c('C. parvum', 
                                                    'C. hominis'))

4.2 Plot

CSpV1_plot <- ggbarplot(
  CSpV1_dat,
  'Strain',
  'CSpV1.GAPDH',
  fill = '#ffd966',
  color = 'black',
  position = position_dodge(.85),
  add = c('mean_se',
          'jitter'),
  error.plot = 'upper_errorbar',
  add.params = list(
    color = 'black',
    shape = 21,
    fill = '#ffd966',
    width = .3,
    jitter = .1
  ),
  ylab = 'CSpV1/CpGAPDH',
  xlab = '    ',
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
) %>%
  ggpar(x.text.angle = 45) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(expression(italic('C. parvum')),
                              expression(italic('C. hominis'))))

print(CSpV1_plot)

5 Figure building

cyto_plot / (IFN_plot + CSpV1_plot + 
               plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1)))
